en: I hope you had a jam 'round here while you could, cuz your gig is up!

en: SIRIUS: Get back here!

en: Gave her a solid one straight in the kisser and she didn't so much as flinch.

key: SIRIUS: You might have done well to mind your son,

key: But it's a bit late for that now, isn't it?
en: But it's a bit late for that now, isn't it?

key: SOLARIS: And just what does that mean?
en: SOLARIS: And just what does that mean?
ja: ソラリス: それはどういう意味だ?

key: SIRIUS: Why don't you ask \PN?
en: SIRIUS: Why don't you ask \PN?

key: After all, no one else here was witness to his final moments.
en: After all, no one else here was witness to his final moments.
ja: なにしろ、ここで彼の最期を見届けたのは、あいつだけなんだからな。

key: SOLARIS: His...

ja: ソラリス: あいつの……

key: What?
en: What?
ja: なんだと?

key: SIRIUS: Did your win condition neglect to mention that?
en: SIRIUS: Did your win condition neglect to mention that?

key: SOLARIS: Explain yourself. Now.

ja: ソラリス: 説明しろ。今すぐに。

key: SIRIUS: Shall I?
en: SIRIUS: Shall I?

key: But I'm not sure you're in a position to be giving orders here, commander.
en: But I'm not sure you're in a position to be giving orders here, commander.
ja: だが、命令を出せる立場にあるとは思えないな、司令官。

key: SOLARIS: Do not forget your place.
en: SOLARIS: Do not forget your place.
ja: ソラリス: 己の立場を忘れるな。

key: SIRIUS: As I see it, I understand my place a great deal better than you do yours.
en: SIRIUS: As I see it, I understand my place a great deal better than you do yours.
ja: シリウス: オレに言わせりゃ、自分の立場をよっぽど分かってるのはオレのほうだけどな。

key: Consider the following.
en: Consider the following.
ja: 考えてもみろ。

key: You've expended your Pokémon's strength.
en: You've expended your Pokémon's strength.
ja: お前はもうポケモンの力を使い果たした。

key: Your ace in the hole has her own intentions.
en: Your ace in the hole has her own intentions.
ja: お前の切り札は、自分の思惑で勝手に動いてる。

key: And look around--
en: And look around--
ja: それに、周りを見てみろ――

key: Are these faces you know?
en: Are these faces you know?
ja: 見覚えのある顔か?

key: Is this your team?
en: Is this your team?
ja: これがお前のチームか?

key: Or is this the team that I acquired through Dr. Connal?
en: Or is this the team that I acquired through Dr. Connal?
ja: それとも、コナル博士を通じてオレが手に入れたチームか?

key: Their contracts are with me-- not your shambling organization.
en: Their contracts are with me-- not your shambling organization.
ja: 契約相手はオレだ――お前のよろよろした組織じゃない。

key: SIRIUS: The truth you can't admit is,
en: SIRIUS: The truth you can't admit is,
ja: シリウス: お前が認められない真実はな、

key: You are alone in your goals.
en: You are alone in your goals.
ja: お前は自分の目標において、独りだってことだ。

key: "Protect the old world?"

key: Who's going to care about that?
en: Who's going to care about that?

key: Even the core grunts are recruited under promise of a new life.

key: Surely you must have known this would happen.

key: Even at the beginning, you could only chase those keys because I told you what they had become.

ja: そもそもの始まりからして、あの鍵を追えたのは、オレがそれが何になったかを教えたからだ。

key: You should have listened to that woman.

ja: あの女の言うことを聞いておくべきだったな。

key: In the end, it comes down to power.
en: In the end, it comes down to power.
ja: 結局のところ、すべては力に行き着く。

key: And you've blindly depended on ours for far too long.

ja: そしてお前は、あまりに長くオレたちの力に盲目的に頼ってきた。

key: So I ask you, "commander",

key: Who, really, is out of place here?

key: SOLARIS: ...

key: SIRIUS: A cowardly move, but there is no other for him.

ja: シリウス: 臆病な手だが、あいつにはそれしかできないんだろうな。

key: I will go see if this loose end cannot be tied up.
en: I will go see if this loose end cannot be tied up.
ja: この後始末をつけられるか、見に行くとするか。

key: HARDY: Now's our chance, mates!
en: HARDY: Now's our chance, mates!
ja: ハーディ: 今がチャンスだぜ、みんな!

key: SAMSON: Thanks, kid.
en: SAMSON: Thanks, kid.
ja: サムソン: ありがとよ、坊主。

key: All right, Meteors, brace yourselves.
en: All right, Meteors, brace yourselves.
ja: よし、メテオども、覚悟しな。

key: SAMSON: I've got you, sweetie, just hold on.
en: SAMSON: I've got you, sweetie, just hold on.
ja: サムソン: 大丈夫だ、お嬢さん、しっかりしてくれ。

key: CIEL: Gracious, but I'm afraid if you call me that again, I can't be held responsible for what happens to you!
en: CIEL: Gracious, but I'm afraid if you call me that again, I can't be held responsible for what happens to you!
ja: シエル: あら、でも、もう一度そう呼んだら、あなたに何が起きても責任は持てませんわよ!

key: SAMSON: Sounds like a date.
en: SAMSON: Sounds like a date.
ja: サムソン: デートみたいだな。

key: CIEL: On second thought, Team Meteor can take you back.
en: CIEL: On second thought, Team Meteor can take you back.
ja: シエル: やっぱり、チームメテオに連れ戻してもらいましょうかしら。

key: And I pity anyone who has to stay with these troglodytes for long at all.
en: And I pity anyone who has to stay with these troglodytes for long at all.
ja: こんな穴居人たちと長く一緒にいなきゃいけない人がいたら、気の毒に思いますわ。

key: Don't they know black as a dominant color is sooo out of fashion?
en: Don't they know black as a dominant color is sooo out of fashion?
ja: 黒を基調にするなんて、もう時代遅れだって知らないのかしら?

key: The Relic Stone will be ours without fail!
en: The Relic Stone will be ours without fail!
ja: レリックストーンは必ずわれわれの手に!

key: Come on, it's not like this city is using it anymore...
en: Come on, it's not like this city is using it anymore...
ja: もう、この街だって使ってないんだから別にいいでしょ……

key: We need that stone to make our Lord shine!
en: We need that stone to make our Lord shine!
ja: あの石は、我らが主を輝かせるために必要なのだ!

key: The treasure in this city belongs to the Lord and the Lord alone!
en: The treasure in this city belongs to the Lord and the Lord alone!
ja: この街の宝は、主お一人のものだ!

key: The Lord will triumph by our power!
en: The Lord will triumph by our power!
ja: 主は、われらの力によって勝利される!

key: Lady Lin insists this is Arceus' desire. We are compelled to act.
en: Lady Lin insists this is Arceus' desire. We are compelled to act.
ja: リン様は、これがアルセウスの御意志だと仰せだ。われらは動かねばならぬ。

key: SERRA: I can take care of this much, \PN.
en: SERRA: I can take care of this much, \PN.
ja: セラ: これくらい、あたしで十分よ、\PN。

key: Go help the others.
en: Go help the others.
ja: 他のみんなを助けに行って。

key: I'll probably be fine no matter what.
en: I'll probably be fine no matter what.
ja: どうなっても、多分平気だから。

key: After all, this is way easier than fighting you.
en: After all, this is way easier than fighting you.
ja: だって、あんたと戦うよりずっと楽だもの。

key: Halt! I won't let you go any further!
en: Halt! I won't let you go any further!
ja: 止まれ! これ以上先には行かせない!

key: ...Yet. There was supposed to be a 'yet' after what I said before.
en: ...Yet. There was supposed to be a 'yet' after what I said before.
ja: ……まだ、だ。さっき言ったことの後には"まだ"って続くはずだったんだ。

key: All we have to do is stall...
en: All we have to do is stall...
ja: オレたちはただ時間を稼げばいい……

key: Hey, can't we have just a little more time before YOU show up?!
en: Hey, can't we have just a little more time before YOU show up?!
ja: なあ、お前が現れるまでにもうちょっと時間くれてもよくないか!?

key: That's a 'no', right? That looks like a 'no'.
en: That's a 'no', right? That looks like a 'no'.
ja: "ノー"ってことだよな? どう見ても"ノー"だ。

key: That's okay, soon it won't matter at all...
en: That's okay, soon it won't matter at all...
ja: まあいいさ、どうせすぐにどうでもよくなる……

key: Ugh, how even do I--
en: Ugh, how even do I--
ja: ああ、どうやったら――

key: Oh, a Trainer. Come to see what I'm up to over here?
en: Oh, a Trainer. Come to see what I'm up to over here?
ja: ああ、トレーナーか。オレが何してるか見に来たのか?

key: Oh, wait, you're the Trainer who saved the city! Thanks for that.
en: Oh, wait, you're the Trainer who saved the city!  Thanks for that.
ja: あ、待てよ、街を救ったトレーナーじゃないか! ありがとな。

key: I suppose I could let you in on what I'm working on.
en: I suppose I could let you in on what I'm working on.
ja: オレが何をやってるか、教えてやってもいいぜ。

key: I was curious about some rumors-- you know the ones-- and checked out that weird underwater forest. I found a box.
en: I was curious about some rumors-- you know the ones-- and checked out that weird underwater forest. I found a box.
ja: あるうわさが気になってさ――ほら、あれだよ――で、あの変な水中の森を調べてみたら、箱を見つけたんだ。

key: Sealed and unmarked, aside from a name. I don't know what it used to say, but I think it looks like "yoink".
en: Sealed and unmarked, aside from a name. I don't know what it used to say, but I think it looks like "yoink".
ja: 封がしてあって、名前以外は何も書いてなかった。元々何て書いてあったかは分かんねえけど、"yoink"って読めるような気がする。

key: Anyway, so I opened the box-- and I found a Snag Machine!
en: Anyway, so I opened the box-- and I found a Snag Machine!
ja: とにかく、その箱を開けてみたら――スナッチマシンを見つけたんだ!

key: It was rusted and unusable, but I'm fixing it up over here.
en: It was rusted and unusable, but I'm fixing it up over here.
ja: さびついて使い物にならなかったけど、こうやって直してるところさ。

key: Oh, purely for historical value, of course. I've no interest in stealing Pokémon.
en: Oh, purely for historical value, of course. I've no interest in stealing Pokémon.
ja: ああ、もちろん純粋に歴史的価値のためだぜ。ポケモンを盗む気なんてさらさらない。

key: (Please don't call the cops.)
en: (Please don't call the cops.)
ja: (警察には言わないでくれよな。)

key: Anyway, I wonder what a Snag Machine was doing in a place like that...
en: Anyway, I wonder what a Snag Machine was doing in a place like that...
ja: それにしても、あんな場所にスナッチマシンがあったなんて不思議だよな……

key: Don't worry about me, Trainer. I'm just worried Surfing out of here will damage the Machine further.
en: Don't worry about me, Trainer. I'm just worried Surfing out of here will damage the Machine further.
ja: オレのことは気にすんな、トレーナー。ただ、なみのりでここを出たらマシンがさらに壊れないか心配なだけさ。

key: Out cold...
en: Out cold...
ja: 完全に伸びてる……

key: I'd love it if I wasn't trapped here, but I'm too scared to move...
en: I'd love it if I wasn't trapped here, but I'm too scared to move...
ja: ここに閉じ込められてなかったらよかったのに、怖くて動けない……

key: This is our home! You expect us to roll over and just let you take it?!
en: This is our home! You expect us to roll over and just let you take it?!
ja: ここはあたしたちの家よ! おとなしく明け渡すとでも思ってるの!?

key: Ah, you were one of the folks we saw helping fight to get the city back from Team Meteor, right?
en: Ah, you were one of the folks we saw helping fight to get the city back from Team Meteor, right?
ja: ああ、あんた、チームメテオから街を取り戻す戦いを手伝ってたやつだよな?

key: Thank you so much for protecting our home!
en: Thank you so much for protecting our home!
ja: 家を守ってくれて本当にありがとう!

key: Please open, please open, please open!
en: Please open, please open, please open!
ja: お願い、開いて、開いて、開いて!

key: Are you here to help defend the city?
en: Are you here to help defend the city?
ja: 街を守るために来てくれたの?

key: Anything is appreciated!
en: Anything is appreciated!
ja: どんな助けでもありがたいわ!

key: We'll take care of things here, but I'm sure there are other parts that need help.
en: We'll take care of things here, but I'm sure there are other parts that need help.
ja: ここはあたしたちで何とかするけど、他にも助けが必要なところがあるはずよ。

key: Take this for the fight. Maybe it'll help.
en: Take this for the fight. Maybe it'll help.
ja: 戦いに使って。役に立つかもしれないから。

key: Ferrothron is focused on the battle!
en: Ferrothron is focused on the battle!
ja: ナットレイはバトルに集中している!

key: Ugh, I missed so many episodes of my favorite show while I was out...
en: Ugh, I missed so many episodes of my favorite show while I was out...
ja: ああ、逃げてる間に、お気に入りの番組を何話も見逃しちゃった……

key: Worst of all, my legs are too cramped to even sit at home and watch it now!
en: Worst of all, my legs are too cramped to even sit at home and watch it now!
ja: 最悪なのは、脚がつっちゃって家で座って見ることすらできないことよ!

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: Hmph. My only orders are to keep you at bay for a while anyway.
en: Hmph. My only orders are to keep you at bay for a while anyway.
ja: フン。どうせ私の命令は、しばらくお前を足止めすることだけだ。

key: Even if I lose, that mission is accomplished.
en: Even if I lose, that mission is accomplished.
ja: 負けたとしても、その任務は達成される。

key: SERRA: You know, it's nice to have an easy win for once.
en: SERRA: You know, it's nice to have an easy win for once.
ja: セラ: たまには楽な勝ちっていうのもいいものね。

key: Don't worry, I'll clean this up.
en: Don't worry, I'll clean this up.
ja: 心配しないで、あたしが片付けとくから。

key: TITANIA: Get back already!
en: TITANIA: Get back already!
ja: ティタニア: さっさと下がってなさい!

key: If you stand there, you might get hit, so go help somewhere else already!
en: If you stand there, you might get hit, so go help somewhere else already!
ja: そこにいたら巻き込まれるかもしれないから、他のところを手伝いに行きなさいよ!

key: Heracross is focused on the battle!
en: Heracross is focused on the battle!
ja: ヘラクロスはバトルに集中している!

key: FLORINIA: Opposition surrounded.
en: FLORINIA: Opposition surrounded.
ja: フロリニア: 敵、包囲完了。

key: Containment in progress.
en: Containment in progress.
ja: 制圧、進行中。

key: No threats detected.
en: No threats detected.
ja: 脅威は検出されていない。

key: Cradily is focused on the battle!
en: Cradily is focused on the battle!
ja: ユレイドルはバトルに集中している!

key: Geez, it's so nice to finally be able to walk around my home city again.
en: Geez, it's so nice to finally be able to walk around my home city again.
ja: はぁ、ようやく地元の街を歩けるようになって、本当にいい気分。

key: That circus smelled bad anyway!
en: That circus smelled bad anyway!
ja: あのサーカス、どうせ臭かったし!

key: Cacturne is focused on the battle!
en: Cacturne is focused on the battle!
ja: ノクタスはバトルに集中している!

key: If this is the fate the Lord wishes, then this is the fate the Lord shall have.
en: If this is the fate the Lord wishes, then this is the fate the Lord shall have.
ja: これが主の望まれる運命ならば、それが主の運命となるでしょう。

key: E-everything's... It'll be all right, right?
en: E-everything's... It'll be all right, right?
ja: だ、大丈夫……ですよね?

key: I don't know what's going on, but I saw a woman with green hair just outright walk into the water a moment ago...
en: I don't know what's going on, but I saw a woman with green hair just outright walk into the water a moment ago...
ja: 何が起きてるのか分からないけど、さっき緑髪の女の人が、そのまま水の中に歩いていくのを見たの……

key: This isn't like, some creepy zombie story, right?
en: This isn't like, some creepy zombie story, right?
ja: これって、その、不気味なゾンビの話とかじゃないよね?

key: My text is actually copy-pasted, but I can't be reached anyway!
en: My text is actually copy-pasted, but I can't be reached anyway!
ja: このセリフ、実はコピペなんだけど、どうせ連絡もつかないし!

key: It's okay, everyone's fighting for the city.
en: It's okay, everyone's fighting for the city.
ja: 大丈夫、みんな街のために戦ってるから。

key: Don't cry, you'll be all right...
en: Don't cry, you'll be all right...
ja: 泣かないで、大丈夫だから……

key: Celebi is looking at you expectantly.
en: Celebi is looking at you expectantly.
ja: セレビィが期待するような目でこちらを見ている。

key: Now that you've helped it get healthy, it looks like Celebi wants to join you!
en: Now that you've helped it get healthy, it looks like Celebi wants to join you!
ja: 元気にしてあげたことで、セレビィは一緒に来たがっているようだ!

key: Do you want to take Celebi with you?
en: Do you want to take Celebi with you?
ja: セレビィを連れていきますか?

key: Celebi seems a little disappointed, but it will wait here for you.
en: Celebi seems a little disappointed, but it will wait here for you.
ja: セレビィは少しがっかりしたようだが、ここで待っていてくれるようだ。

key: Not even divinity can save you now!
en: Not even divinity can save you now!
ja: もはや神性ですら、お前を救いはしない!

key: How could this happen!?
en: How could this happen!?
ja: どうしてこんなことに!?

key: When will it finally end?
en: When will it finally end?
ja: いったいいつ終わるんだ?

key: Can you just leave us alone for once!?
en: Can you just leave us alone for once!?
ja: 一度くらい、あたしたちを放っといてくれない!?

key: When is enough enough for you people?
en: When is enough enough for you people?
ja: あんたたち、いったいどこまでやれば気が済むのよ。

key: Get out of here and let me patch this guy up.
en: Get out of here and let me patch this guy up.
ja: さっさとどっか行って、こいつの手当てをさせて。

key: Organized criminals aren't the only ones to be too rough on their opponents.
en: Organized criminals aren't the only ones to be too rough on their opponents.
ja: 相手に手荒なことをするのは、何も組織犯罪者だけとは限らないわよ。

key: "Agate City Gym"
en: "Agate City Gym"
ja: 「アゲートシティジム」

key: SHELLY: First Cain and now this...
en: SHELLY: First Cain and now this...
ja: シェリー: 最初はカインで、今度はこれ……

key: I-- I froze up...
en: I-- I froze up...
ja: わ、わたし、体が固まっちゃって……

key: Why couldn't I do anything?
en: Why couldn't I do anything?
ja: どうして何もできなかったんだろう?

key: It's my fault--
en: It's my fault--
ja: わたしのせいで――

key: I saw Lin trying to leave and asked Samson and Ciel for help to stop her...
en: I saw Lin trying to leave and asked Samson and Ciel for help to stop her...
ja: リンが立ち去ろうとしているのを見て、サムソンとシエルに止めるのを手伝ってって頼んで……

key: I saw Lin trying to leave and was worrying about what to do when Ciel approached me...
en: I saw Lin trying to leave and was worrying about what to do when Ciel approached me...
ja: リンが立ち去ろうとしているのを見て、どうしようって悩んでいたら、シエルが近づいてきて……

key: Should I have done it alone?
en: Should I have done it alone?
ja: わたし一人でやるべきだった?

key: Should I have just let her go?
en: Should I have just let her go?
ja: それとも、そのまま行かせるべきだった?

key: I don't--
en: I don't--
ja: わからな――

key: HARDY: No way. Then she'd just have gotten you instead.
en: HARDY: No way. Then she'd just have gotten you instead.
ja: ハーディ: そんなわけねえだろ。そうしてたら、代わりにお前がやられてただけだ。

key: HARDY: I'm not sayin' anyone's more valuable than anyone else,
en: HARDY: I'm not sayin' anyone's more valuable than anyone else,
ja: ハーディ: 誰かが誰かより価値があるとか、そういう話じゃねえ、

key: But at the least, it'll do more harm than good if you don't let up on yourself.
en: But at the least, it'll do more harm than good if you don't let up on yourself.
ja: だが少なくとも、自分を責め続けるのは、害にしかならねえぜ。

key: Ain't no one can blame you for not taking on somethin' you can't handle.
en: Ain't no one can blame you for not taking on somethin' you can't handle.
ja: 手に負えねえことに手を出さなかったからって、誰もお前を責めやしねえよ。

key: So chin up, Shell Bell.
en: So chin up, Shell Bell.
ja: だから元気出せよ、シェルベル。

key: The best way to honor those that ain' with us is to not let that loss stop us from doin' what we gotta.
en: The best way to honor those that ain' with us is to not let that loss stop us from doin' what we gotta.
ja: いなくなったやつを一番弔う方法は、その喪失に足を止めさせず、やるべきことをやり続けることだ。

key: The others have rounded up a bunch of Meteor's goons and they're takin' 'em into the city to lock 'em down.
en: The others have rounded up a bunch of Meteor's goons and they're takin' 'em into the city to lock 'em down.
ja: 他のやつらがメテオの手下どもを大勢捕まえて、街に連れてって閉じ込めてるところだ。

key: They've got their Pokémon helpin', but I can't imagine they couldn't use another set of hands.
en: They've got their Pokémon helpin', but I can't imagine they couldn't use another set of hands.
ja: ポケモンにも手伝わせてるけど、人手だってあって困ることはねえだろ。

key: Why don't you roll out with them?
en: Why don't you roll out with them?
ja: お前も一緒に行ってみたらどうだ?

key: SHELLY: O-okay...
en: SHELLY: O-okay...
ja: シェリー: は、はい……

key: HARDY: My sis is with them.
en: HARDY: My sis is with them.
ja: ハーディ: オレの妹もそこにいる。

key: She may not be good for much more than sharp words most of the time,
en: She may not be good for much more than sharp words most of the time,
ja: 普段は口の悪さくらいしか取り柄がねえけどよ、

key: But the two of them seemed to be hittin' it off earlier, her helping Shell Bell with the whole backbone thing.
en: But the two of them seemed to be hittin' it off earlier, her helping Shell Bell with the whole backbone thing.
ja: さっき、根性のことでシェルベルを助けてやってたみてえで、二人はうまくやってるみたいだったぜ。

key: HARDY: That bird Serra's with them.
en: HARDY: That bird Serra's with them.
ja: ハーディ: あの鳥のセラもそこにいる。

key: The two of them were hittin' it off earlier when they were both dealing with their own losses.
en: The two of them were hittin' it off earlier when they were both dealing with their own losses.
ja: さっき、お互いの喪失に向き合ってるとこで、二人はうまくやってるみたいだったぜ。

key: I think she'll be good for her.
en: I think she'll be good for her.
ja: あいつなら、シェリーにとっていいと思うぜ。

key: HARDY: Welp, one way or another, that just about takes care of Meteor for here.
en: HARDY: Welp, one way or another, that just about takes care of Meteor for here.
ja: ハーディ: ま、なんだかんだで、ここらのメテオはこれで片付いたな。

key: It's good to be home.
en: It's good to be home.
ja: やっぱり地元はいいもんだぜ。

key: I'mma go hit up the townsfolk and tell 'em that it's safe now.
en: I'mma go hit up the townsfolk and tell 'em that it's safe now.
ja: 街の連中のところに行って、もう安全だって伝えてくるぜ。

key: After that...
en: After that...
ja: それが終わったら……

key: Heh, you already know what I'm gonna ask, right?
en: Heh, you already know what I'm gonna ask, right?
ja: へっ、オレが何を聞きたいか、もう分かってんだろ?

key: I've been lookin' forward to a battle with you ever since I saw you fight Aya.
en: I've been lookin' forward to a battle with you ever since I saw you fight Aya.
ja: お前がアヤと戦うのを見てからずっと、お前とのバトルを楽しみにしてたんだ。

key: It's gonna feel GREAT to use my Gym again!
en: It's gonna feel GREAT to use my Gym again!
ja: オレのジムをまた使えるなんて、最高の気分だぜ!

key: Then we can roll back up to Calcenon and find a way to save Aya.
en: Then we can roll back up to Calcenon and find a way to save Aya.
ja: それが終わったら、カルセノンに戻ってアヤを救う方法を見つけよう。

key: Sound good to you?
en: Sound good to you?
ja: それでいいか?

key: I'll be waitin', mate!
en: I'll be waitin', mate!
ja: 待ってるぜ、相棒!

key: CIEL: Now, now! You can't possibly leave until the show is rightfully over!
en: CIEL: Now, now! You can't possibly leave until the show is rightfully over!
ja: シエル: あらあら! ショーがきちんと終わるまでは、帰らせませんわよ!

key: SAMSON: While you're at it, how about you hand over whatever that big stone business is.
en: SAMSON: While you're at it, how about you hand over whatever that big stone business is.
ja: サムソン: ついでに、そのでっかい石とやらも渡してもらおうか。

key: LIN: Who makes demands with their cheek on the ground?
en: LIN: Who makes demands with their cheek on the ground?
ja: リン: ほおを地に伏せた者が、要求などできましょうか?

key: All the souls in this world insist on mercy.
en: All the souls in this world insist on mercy.
ja: この世のすべての魂が、慈悲を求めるもの。

key: But there is none.
en: But there is none.
ja: けれど、慈悲などありはしません。

key: And I'm afraid we'll have to ask you to leave your...
en: And I'm afraid we'll have to ask you to leave your...
ja: それと、恐れながら、あなた方の……

key: Whatever that is...
en: Whatever that is...
ja: それが何であれ、置いていっていただきますわ……

key: At the front desk.
en: At the front desk.
ja: フロントデスクにて。

key: LIN: The world stage does not belong to you alone.
en: LIN: The world stage does not belong to you alone.
ja: リン: この世という舞台は、あなただけのものではありませんわ。

key: It is full of characters who think only of themselves.
en: It is full of characters who think only of themselves.
ja: 自分のことしか考えない登場人物で満ちておりますの。

key: A world like this cannot exist any other way.
en: A world like this cannot exist any other way.
ja: このような世界は、他のあり方では存在し得ませんわ。

key: CIEL: I do hope you don't intend to take the moral high ground after everything you've done.
en: CIEL: I do hope you don't intend to take the moral high ground after everything you've done.
ja: シエル: そこまでのことをしておいて、道徳的優位に立とうなどとは思っていないでしょうね。

key: LIN: Morals are only lies we choose to believe in for our own comfort.
en: LIN: Morals are only lies we choose to believe in for our own comfort.
ja: リン: 道徳とは、己を慰めるために信じることを選んだうそにすぎませんわ。

key: Such fictions have no bearing on this world.
en: Such fictions have no bearing on this world.
ja: そのような虚構は、この世界には何の意味も持ちません。

key: All that matters is control.
en: All that matters is control.
ja: 大切なのは、支配することだけ。

key: Who can make the other man bow?
en: Who can make the other man bow?
ja: 誰が相手をひざまずかせられるか。

key: Who can make the other one kneel?
en: Who can make the other one kneel?
ja: 誰が相手を屈服させられるか。

key: Who can make the other disappear?
en: Who can make the other disappear?
ja: 誰が相手を消し去れるか。

key: And who can bring them back?
en: And who can bring them back?
ja: そして、誰がその者を連れ戻せるか。

key: GARDEVOIR: ...
en: GARDEVOIR: ...
ja: サーナイト: ……

key: LIN: What is lost can yet be found.
en: LIN: What is lost can yet be found.
ja: リン: 失われたものは、また見出されましょう。

key: What is found can be extorted.
en: What is found can be extorted.
ja: 見出されたものは、奪い取られましょう。

key: What's extorted is forgotten.
en: What's extorted is forgotten.
ja: 奪われたものは、忘れ去られましょう。

key: What's forgotten is your place.
en: What's forgotten is your place.
ja: 忘れ去られる、それがあなたの居場所ですわ。

key: SAMSON: Look out!
en: SAMSON: Look out!
ja: サムソン: 危ねえ!

key: CIEL: No, what are you--
en: CIEL: No, what are you--
ja: シエル: いけません、何を――

key: CIEL: ...
en: CIEL: ...
ja: シエル: ……

key: What... happened?
en: What... happened?
ja: 何が……起きたの?

key: Where did he go?
en: Where did he go?
ja: 彼はどこへ……?

key: What did you do with Samson?!
en: What did you do with Samson?!
ja: サムソンをどうしたの!?

key: LIN: Why should the sun care if the stars go out?
en: LIN: Why should the sun care if the stars go out?
ja: リン: 星が消えたところで、太陽が気にかける理由がありましょうか?

key: It is still the center of its own world,
en: It is still the center of its own world,
ja: 太陽は今もなお、己の世界の中心であり、

key: Unable to see past its own sheen.
en: Unable to see past its own sheen.
ja: 己の輝きの向こうを見ることはできません。

key: Shield your eyes, or burn them out.
en: Shield your eyes, or burn them out.
ja: 目を守るか、それとも焼き尽くされるか。

key: It makes no difference.
en: It makes no difference.
ja: どちらでも構いはしませんわ。

key: SAMSON: Ciel--
en: SAMSON: Ciel--
ja: サムソン: シエル――

key: SAMSON: No-- Too late--
en: SAMSON: No-- Too late--
ja: サムソン: だめだ――間に合わねえ――

key: What did you do to her?!
en: What did you do to her?!
ja: あいつに何をしやがった!?

key: You'd better bring her back this instant!
en: You'd better bring her back this instant!
ja: 今すぐ元に戻しやがれ!

key: LIN: Who can make the other man bow?
en: LIN: Who can make the other man bow?
ja: リン: 誰が相手をひざまずかせられるか。

key: Who makes demands with their cheek on the ground?
en: Who makes demands with their cheek on the ground?
ja: ほおを地に伏せた者が、要求などできましょうか?

key: You may kiss the dirt, and nothing more.
en: You may kiss the dirt, and nothing more.
ja: あなたにできるのは、土に口づけることだけ。

key: It's all you ever had.
en: It's all you ever had.
ja: それが、あなたの持てるすべて。

key: SHELLY: Huh...?
en: SHELLY: Huh...?
ja: シェリー: え……?

key: Again...?
en: Again...?
ja: また……?

key: CIEL: Of course I care...
en: CIEL: Of course I care...
ja: シエル: もちろん、気にかけていますわ……

key: I always cared...
en: I always cared...
ja: ずっと、気にかけてきました……

key: SHELLY: Another black hole?
en: SHELLY: Another black hole?
ja: シェリー: また、ブラックホール……?

key: That Gardevoir... It's just like with Cain...
en: That Gardevoir... It's just like with Cain...
ja: あのサーナイト……カインの時と同じ……

key: CIEL: Even if it wasn't how he wanted--
en: CIEL: Even if it wasn't how he wanted--
ja: シエル: たとえ彼の望んだ形ではなかったとしても――

key: Even if I couldn't say it--
en: Even if I couldn't say it--
ja: たとえ言葉にできなかったとしても――

key: And just what does she know?!
en: And just what does she know?!
ja: あの女に、いったい何がわかるというの!?

key: SHELLY: Why did it listen to her?
en: SHELLY: Why did it listen to her?
ja: シェリー: どうして、あの人の言うことを聞いたの?

key: Why couldn't we do anything, again?
en: Why couldn't we do anything, again?
ja: どうしてまた、わたしたちは何もできなかったの?

key: Did I do something wrong asking for help stopping her?
en: Did I do something wrong asking for help stopping her?
ja: あの人を止めるのを手伝ってって頼んだこと、間違ってたのかな?

key: CIEL: No...
en: CIEL: No...
ja: シエル: いいえ……

key: There was nothing we could do, but you weren't wrong to ask us...
en: There was nothing we could do, but you weren't wrong to ask us...
ja: わたくしたちにできることは何もなかった、けれどあなたが頼んだことは間違いではありませんでしたわ……

key: CIEL: As always, I just wasn't enough...
en: CIEL: As always, I just wasn't enough...
ja: シエル: いつものように、わたくしはただ、力不足だっただけ……

key: I've never been--
en: I've never been--
ja: ずっと、足りていなかった――

key: This is... disgraceful.
en: This is... disgraceful.
ja: これは……無様ですわね。

key: I should go.
en: I should go.
ja: 行かなくては。

key: SAMSON: DAMN IT!
en: SAMSON: DAMN IT!
ja: サムソン: クソが!

key: Another black hole?
en: Another black hole?
ja: また、ブラックホールか?

key: SAMSON: Curse that bitch...
en: SAMSON: Curse that bitch...
ja: サムソン: あのアマ……

key: Ciel--
en: Ciel--
ja: シエル――

key: I'm sorry I wasn't here.
en: I'm sorry I wasn't here.
ja: ここにいてやれなくて、悪かったな。

key: I'll crush her head in...
en: I'll crush her head in...
ja: あいつの頭をかち割ってやる……

key: I'll find her and I'll crush her entire--
en: I'll find her and I'll crush her entire--
ja: あいつを見つけて、身体ごとたたき潰して――

key: Ugh.
en: Ugh.
ja: くそっ。

key: Did I do something wrong asking her to help stop Lin...?
en: Did I do something wrong asking her to help stop Lin...?
ja: リンを止めるのを手伝ってもらったこと、間違ってたのか……?

key: If I were stronger--
en: If I were stronger--
ja: オレがもっと強かったら――

key: SAMSON: Shut up.
en: SAMSON: Shut up.
ja: サムソン: 黙れ。

key: SHELLY: H-huh?
en: SHELLY: H-huh?
ja: シェリー: え……?

key: SAMSON: I should've been there with her.
en: SAMSON: I should've been there with her.
ja: サムソン: オレがあいつのそばにいてやるべきだった。

key: I should've--
en: I should've--
ja: オレが……

key: SAMSON: ...
en: SAMSON: ...
ja: サムソン: ……

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: もういい。

key: I'll go pity myself elsewhere.
en: I'll go pity myself elsewhere.
ja: よそで自分をあわれんでくるとするか。

key: SAMSON: Move it.
en: SAMSON: Move it.
ja: サムソン: どけ。

key: SHELLY: Why does this keep happening...?
en: SHELLY: Why does this keep happening...?
ja: シェリー: どうして、こんなことばかり続くの……?
\PN……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
